title: RevoBank: Credit Card Performance & Customer Segmentation
summary: Customer segmentation and credit card performance analysis to identify growth opportunities and manage financial risk.
problem: RevoBank needed to increase credit card engagement and MDR revenue while minimizing fraud-related losses.
goal: Identify transaction patterns and customer inactivity
Segment customers based on transaction behaviour and financial profiles
Evaluate fraud exposure and customer debt levels
keyFindings: Estimated MDR contribution after reported fraud losses reached Rp5.66B
Fraud represented 0.10% of transaction count and 0.26% of transaction value
VIP customers represented 17.20% of the customer base
Dormant customers represented 38.48% of the customer base
recommendations: Implement tiered loyalty programs and personalized offers
Launch targeted win-back campaigns for dormant customers
Strengthen transaction monitoring and step-up authentication
metrics: Rp7.11M VIP net profit per customer
